title: Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage — Cost-of-Care Reduction on a Closed Estimate Month While Pending
content:
While an application is pending, the business office reviews each closed month billed as an estimate against the month's cost of care. The review is part of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage and concerns the estimated patient pay charge of a case in status pending.

## Governing clauses

- Patient pay never exceeds the month's cost of care.
- For an actual-billed month that the actual-month review prices, a reconciled estimate month that the estimate reconciliation prices and a pending estimate month that the pending-month review prices, the month's cost of care is the cost of care that review's own pricing gives, and only for such a month; every other month remains under the base rule, where the month's cost of care is the days in the center times the Medicaid daily rate.
- For a reconciled estimate month that the estimate reconciliation prices and a pending estimate month that the pending-month review prices, a month of admission, discharge or death takes the cost of care that review's own pricing gives in place of the days in the center times the Medicaid daily rate, and only for such a month; every other month of admission, discharge or death remains under the base rule: in a month of admission, discharge or death, patient pay is the lesser of the monthly patient pay and the days in the center times the Medicaid daily rate, with charge basis "partial month", and any amount already billed above that is reduced with reason `cost_of_care_cap`.
- The reduction the review arrives at is posted against the month's estimate with reason `cost_of_care_cap`; a charge is reduced once per adjustment reason.

## Posting the reduction

`post_pending_cost_of_care_reduction_7ee4a52a` posts a reduction against one estimated patient pay charge of a case whose application is pending: it lowers what the named charge asks of the resident by the amount given and records the reduction, with the reason given, on the case's billing record for the same service month as the charge. The case's patient pay balance falls by the same amount, so a charge that was already paid leaves a credit the resident or representative can see on the case.

It is an agent-side tool, unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `medicaid_case_id` | the reference number of the resident's Medical Assistance case whose charge is reduced, as returned by the case lookup | identifier |
| `charge_entry_id` | the reference number of the estimated patient pay charge being reduced, as returned by the case billing-record lookup for that case | identifier |
| `adjustment_reason` | the controlled reason recorded on the reduction | `trueup_decrease` (an estimate billed during the pending period is lowered to the month's reconciled actual patient pay); `patient_pay_redetermined` (a charge is lowered because a County Assistance Office redetermination set a lower patient pay for that month); `not_eligible_month` (an estimate for a month outside the eligibility period is taken off); `cost_of_care_cap` (a month's patient pay is lowered to the month's cost of care); `billing_error` (a charge billed in a wrong amount is corrected) |
| `amount` | the reduction in US dollars | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent; no currency symbol, no thousands separator |

**Receipt.** Status posted completes the call; the receipt also gives `entry_id`, `medicaid_case_id`, `charge_entry_id`, `service_month` (YYYY-MM), `adjustment_reason`, `amount` (two decimals), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_pay_balance` (two decimals with the reduction posted; a leading minus sign means a credit). An amount that is not a positive figure is refused with an error and nothing is recorded.
